title: Vacancy-Driven Gelation Using Defect-Rich Nanoassemblies of 2D Transition Metal Dichalcogenides and Polymeric Binder for Biomedical Applications

nodes.label: Cell encapsulation needs a hydrogel that sets without UV or heat, stays stiff and elastic, and tolerates living cells during gelation
Pristine 2D MoS2 has too few planar defects to conjugate polymer chains, and MoS2-driven gelation has not been reported
Constraining lattice growth to leave atomic vacancies should create active centres that chemisorb thiolated PEG and gel it with no external stimulus
Defect-rich 2D MoS2 nanoassemblies paired with four-arm PEG-SH as the polymeric binder

attrs.reason: Mo has a strong affinity for thiol sulfur; four arms give a crosslinkable star

nodes.label: Mo:S precursor mole ratio 1:1, 1:2, 1:4 and 1:6, and MoS2 loading 0.25-2 wt% in the gel
Hydrothermal growth from hexaammonium heptamolybdate and thiourea at the chosen Mo:S ratio
Mix the nanoassemblies into four-arm PEG-SH solution; the network forms with no UV or thermal trigger
The product is 2H MoS2 at every precursor ratio
The nanosheets assemble into 1-3 um flower-like spheres of rippled, unstacked petals
Sulfur-rich feeds leave more atomic vacancies in the lattice, giving more active centres

attrs.proxy: Raman A1g/E1-2g intensity ratio and PL defect-band growth

nodes.label: PEG thiols chemisorb at the vacancy sites as Mo-S and S-S links, crosslinking the star polymer into a network
The prepolymer turns strongly shear-thinning: consistency K rises from 7.7 to 2479 and the power-law index falls from 1.0 to about 0.17
Compressive modulus rises from 8.7 to 27.7 kPa as MoS2 goes from 0.25 to 2 wt%
Viability stays near 100% below 50 ug/mL and settles near 60% out to 10 mg/mL, with no IC50 reached
Molybdenum's affinity for sulfur at an exposed vacancy is what binds the thiol, which is why excess free thiol dissolves the network again
hMSCs can be encapsulated simply by mixing: the gel sets within 30 min in culture medium and the cells stay viable at 48 h
Atomic vacancies in 2D MoS2 act as the crosslinker, giving a stimulus-free, stiff, elastomeric and cell-compatible hydrogel
SEM and TEM show 1-3 um spheres built from rippled, unstacked petal-like flakes

nodes.label: The higher-order XRD reflections resolve only at 1:4 and 1:6 while (002) is unchanged, and the rising A1g/E1-2g ratio is itself the standard signature of thicker, more stacked MoS2

attrs.image_note: judge re-read of F1c: the (002) peak has the same width in all four traces - if anything the 1:6 trace is slightly broader at the base - while (103), (006), (105) and (110) go from one unresolved hump at 1:1 to separate peaks at 1:4 and 1:6. So the panel reads as more, not less, crystalline order at the sulfur-rich end. The paper reads the same two observables (this trend and the F1f Raman ratio) as evidence for more defects, while its own text reads the Raman ratio as increased interlayer interaction and crystal thickness; nothing in the packet separates the two.

nodes.label: The EDS confirmation rests on one peak near 2.3 keV where Mo L-alpha and S K-alpha overlap and cannot be separated, with the Pt coating line alongside

attrs.image_note: the Mo and S maps are sparse, low-count and indistinguishable from each other, so they cannot show where MoS2 sits in the 10-20 um pore network

nodes.label: The whole PEG Raman spectrum, C-C, C-O and CH2 bands included, is attenuated to baseline at 2% MoS2

attrs.image_note: so the disappearance of the thiol bands is not specific to bond formation; the paper notes the overall attenuation and still argues from the thiol bands alone

nodes.label: The gels carry 2 wt% MoS2, about 20 mg/mL, above the highest concentration tested for cytotoxicity, where viability is already 59% and the apoptotic fraction is 18%

attrs.image_note: read by setting the gel composition against the F5b abscissa, which stops at 10 mg/mL, and the F5c apoptosis bars at 1000 ug/mL

nodes.label: In 2H MoS2 molybdenum sits in trigonal prismatic coordination bound to six sulfide ligands, so pristine basal planes offer few active centres
Nanosilicates and graphene show IC50 near 5 and 1 mg/mL respectively
Ostwald power-law model eta = K gamma^(n-1), with n = 1 for a Newtonian fluid
Ostwald ripening of hydrothermally grown flakes drives their assembly into flower-like structures
No IC50 is reached even at 10 mg/mL, against about 5 mg/mL for nanosilicates and 1 mg/mL for graphene
No vacancy is ever imaged or counted; defect density is inferred from Raman and PL, and the gels use the 1:4 rather than the nominally most defect-rich 1:6 material

notes: The spine hangs on y10 (vacancy concentration) and y11 (thiol chemisorption at those vacancies), and both are the weakest links in the figures, so the four audits all sit there. a1: the two observables read as more defects - the rising Raman A1g/E1-2g ratio and the sharpening XRD reflections - are the standard signatures of thicker, more crystalline MoS2, and the paper's own text reads the Raman ratio that second way. a3: the entire PEG Raman spectrum is attenuated to baseline at 2% MoS2, so the vanishing thiol bands are not specific evidence of bond formation. a2: the EDS confirmation rests on the unresolved Mo L-alpha / S K-alpha overlap near 2.3 keV. a4: the gels carry ~20 mg/mL MoS2, above the top of the tested cytotoxicity range, where viability is already 59% and apoptosis 18%. Also recorded but not promoted to audits: the ~150 min gelation induction period in water (z6), the non-monotonic power-law index (z5), the Mo(VI)-range XPS component (z10), and the caption's 8-25 kPa against the panel's 27.7 kPa (z7). Lost: the supplementary twist-cycle, cyclic-compression and zeta-potential data, and the stress-relaxation and stress-sweep panels F2e/F2f.

changes: a1: the XRD half of the audit was misread. F1c shows the (002) width unchanged across 1:1 to 1:6 (the 1:6 trace is if anything slightly broader), while the higher-order (103), (006), (105) and (110) reflections go from one unresolved hump at 1:1 to separate peaks at 1:4 and 1:6. Label and image_note rewritten. The audit's point is unchanged and in fact better carried: the sulfur-rich end looks MORE crystalline, which is the opposite of what a defect-density argument wants.

z5 and z7: provenance derived -> measured. Both read the paper's own reduction of curves printed in the same panel (power-law fit parameters; compressive modulus), with no OBS parent in this graph, and v04 requires an incoming derives edge for derived.
z12: figs was ['F5'] while its panel_ids cite #F2d as well as #F5d. Corrected to ['F2','F5'] so figs and panel_ids agree.

y10: attrs.basis argued -> evidenced with attrs.proxy = 'Raman A1g/E1-2g intensity ratio and PL defect-band growth'. The node has two incoming evidences edges (z3, z4), and v04 says evidence through a proxy stays evidenced with the proxy named. The weakness of that proxy is carried where it belongs - on z3/z4 image_support=partial and on the a1 and limy1 qualifies edges.

panel_checks.note: F1f is right (the inset scatter gives 0.67, 1.17, 1.83, 2.28). F1c does NOT show the claim as it was stated: the (002) and (100) reflections do not sharpen across the series; what changes is that the higher-order reflections become resolved. Right panel, wrong reading, so no correct_id; the node has been corrected.

Exactly right, and it is the sharpest audit in the paper. In F4a the whole PEG spectrum - C-O-C, CH2 rock, C-O, C-C and the CH2 twist/bend cluster - is strong at 0%, much weaker at 0.25% and flat at 2%. The thiol bands vanish along with everything else, so their disappearance is not specific evidence of Mo-S bond formation. z9's reading of the two insets also checks out.

Viability reads 106, 101, 98, 76, 66, 63, 62, 59% from 1 ug/mL to 10 mg/mL against a drawn IC50 of 50, never crossed - the node's numbers exactly. Its point that the curve is a plateau from 500 ug/mL rather than a dose response is right, and the abscissa does stop at 10 mg/mL, which is what a4 turns on.

review.audit_summary: 5 audits (a1, a2, a3, a4, limy1), at budget, and all four OBS audits sit on the same two spine nodes (y10 vacancy concentration, y11 thiol chemisorption) - which is correct, because those are the paper's load-bearing and least-evidenced claims. The three kinds are kept apart well: a3 is an outright 'the evidence is not specific' finding, a2 is 'the figure does not resolve it' (the Mo L-alpha / S K-alpha overlap near 2.3 keV), a4 is an extrapolation audit (the gel's ~20 mg/mL sits beyond the tested range), and limy1 states the honest summary that no vacancy is ever imaged. Four further soft spots are correctly kept on image_support instead of becoming nodes: the ~150 min induction period (z6), the non-monotonic power-law index (z5), the Mo(VI)-range XPS component (z10) and the caption's 8-25 kPa against the panel's 27.7 kPa (z7).
